title: ChatGPT voice lets you control your computer and apps hands-free with ease. #AI #ChatGPT #Tech
description:
OpenAI has introduced a major advancement in AI interaction by integrating ChatGPT voice capabilities directly into its desktop app. This update enables users to control their entire computer using natural spoken commands—opening apps, clicking buttons, and completing full tasks hands-free. The core innovation lies in GPT Live, a new set of voice models that allow ChatGPT to listen and speak simultaneously, supporting fluid, interruptible conversations while executing multiple workflows. This development transforms the AI experience from static chatbot exchanges to dynamic, real-time task management, effectively letting users delegate complex workflows to a network of AI agents working simultaneously. For example, ChatGPT can check emails vocally while another AI fixes code, streamlining multitasking and enhancing productivity. Available on both Mac and Windows for paid ChatGPT plans, this feature represents a shift toward voice-driven AI interfaces that operate like a virtual team, fundamentally changing how users interact with software and complete computer tasks. #ChatGPT #OpenAI #VoiceAI
